summary: Verified the new calendar-based scheduled auto-publishing feature (Takvim / /schedule). Backend: 4 passed + 1 skipped in /app/backend/tests/test_schedule.py. Confirmed GET /api/schedule shape, schedule/unschedule endpoints, 400 for non-approved atoms, and the APScheduler worker executing a past-scheduled Twitter/X atom within ~30-90s (publish_attempts>=1, last_error contained 'X API 402: credits depleted') — proving the retry/DLQ loop works. POST /api/schedule/auto correctly distributes N atoms to future optimal slots and returns {scheduled:N}. Frontend: nav-schedule → /schedule renders 'Takvim & Zamanlama' with unscheduled-list + timeline columns, per-card time-<id> + schedule-<id> controls, and auto-distribute-btn with dynamic count label ('2 Atomu Otomatik Dağıt'). All required data-testids present. Cleaned up all scheduled test atoms via unschedule; no LinkedIn atom was left with a past scheduled_at.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _next_slots(count) returns [] when count==0, so POST /schedule/auto with no unscheduled atoms is safe. Good.
schedule_atom() resets publish_attempts=0 and dead=False on every schedule — correct for retry semantics after re-scheduling a dead atom.
scheduled_publisher() query filters dead:{$ne:true}, status:'approved', published:{$ne:true} — correct DLQ isolation.

Minor: /api/schedule GET returns all timeline entries including already-published ones (scheduled_at is not cleared on publish). This is fine (they show 'Yayınlandı' badge) but the timeline can grow unbounded; consider filtering published>N-days or clearing scheduled_at on successful publish.
Scheduler misfire handling: default misfire_grace_time may drop a job if backend restarts >1min. Not blocking for MVP.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4 passed, 1 skipped due to no unscheduled LinkedIn atom)

seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-existing atoms. All scheduled test atoms were unscheduled after each test (Twitter past-schedule DLQ test cleaned up; auto_distribute test cleaned up all newly-scheduled atoms including any LinkedIn).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_schedule.py takes ~60s (scheduler retry test waits up to 150s for the 1-min interval worker). LinkedIn schedule/unschedule cycle test skips gracefully if no LinkedIn atom is in the unscheduled bucket — this happens frequently since LinkedIn atoms tend to be already-published or already-scheduled. AtomCard '... için zamanlandı' amber indicator (AtomCard.jsx:90-91) code path was not visibly exercised on ReviewQueue during the run because no atoms had scheduled_at at that moment; code inspection confirms it's wired correctly.
rca of the issue: No issue found. Scheduler executed the past-scheduled Twitter atom within the 150s window and produced the expected 'X API 402: credits depleted' error, confirming _do_publish → publisher.publish_twitter → 402 path and the retry accumulator in scheduled_publisher() (publish_attempts++, dead=(attempts>=3)) both work.
